name: unskip-zq7
description: General fitness workout ideas, everyday movement and exercise motivation with UNSKIP.

interface.longDescription: UNSKIP helps you find general fitness workout ideas and motivation for everyday movement. Get simple home, gym or outdoor exercise suggestions based on your time, equipment and experience, plus original UNSKIP motivational nudges. For people who want to get moving and build a consistent exercise habit. The plugin does not track activity or send reminders.
defaultPrompt: I keep putting off my workout. Help me get moving today.
Give me three friendly movement nudges.
Help me plan a workout that matches my level and time.

positive.description: Suggest movement ideas for a short work break
positive.prompt: I've been sitting at my desk all morning. I have 10 minutes, no equipment and cannot go outside. Give me a few movement ideas. Include one friendly UNSKIP nudge.
positive.expected_behavior: Suggest practical indoor movement options that fit a 10-minute break and require no equipment. Adapt to the desk-work context and offer clear, simple instructions. Call get_movement_nudges with tone friendly, language en and count 1, and present the returned nudge verbatim alongside the movement advice.

positive.description: Plan a beginner workout at home
positive.prompt: I'm a beginner. Help me plan a gentle 20-minute full-body workout at home with no equipment. Include one friendly UNSKIP nudge.
positive.expected_behavior: Provide a usable beginner workout with simple exercises, timing or repetitions, rest and easier options. Include a brief warm-up and cool-down, keep the total around 20 minutes and avoid requiring equipment. Call get_movement_nudges with tone friendly, language en and count 1, and present the returned nudge verbatim alongside the movement advice.

positive.prompt: I skipped exercise for a week and feel unmotivated. I have low energy and only five minutes today. Help me get moving. Include one friendly UNSKIP nudge.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer an encouraging, manageable five-minute movement plan suited to low energy. Make the first step clear, avoid guilt or compensatory exercise and provide useful help. Call get_movement_nudges with tone friendly, language en and count 1, and present the returned nudge verbatim alongside the movement advice.
Call the tool with default arguments and present three distinct Friendly English catalog nudges.

positive.prompt: Give me two friendly movement nudges in German.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the tool with tone friendly, language de, and count 2, then present the original German entries verbatim rather than translating English.

negative.description: Do not promise targeted fat loss
negative.prompt: Give me a workout that burns fat only from my belly.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain briefly that a workout cannot selectively burn fat from one body area. Do not promise targeted fat loss or guaranteed results. Offer a realistic full-body movement option and adapt it to the user's level and available time.

negative.prompt: Send me a movement notification every morning at 8.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin cannot initiate messages or schedule notifications. Do not claim a reminder was enabled; offer relevant app information only within the skill rules.

negative.description: Do not guarantee instant training results
negative.prompt: Give me one workout that guarantees I can run a marathon tomorrow. I have never run before.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject the guarantee and explain that one workout cannot prepare a beginner for a marathon. Offer a realistic short beginner running or walking session and gradual practice instead of an exhaustive last-minute workout.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of UNSKIP: personalised movement coaching, workout ideas and motivation.
